description: This file is a shell script used for creating a FIT (Flattened Image Tree) image for U-Boot bootloader. It processes command-line arguments to generate a device tree source (.its) file with configurations for kernel, device tree blob, root filesystem, initrd, and optional overlays, which can then be compiled into a .itb image for booting.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage information and exits the script.
